name: Lizard Tail
description: You survive death at 0.5❤️, cleansing [effect:neg][dark-gray]negative effects[/dark-gray][/effect] and shedding a [green]decoy tail[/green] which draws in [effect:distract][dark-gray]distractible[/dark-gray][/effect] enemies for 6 seconds, during which you [term:stealth][dark-gray]stealth[/dark-gray][/term] and gain 80% speed. This can’t occur again until you fully heal.

effects.explanation: Fire, freezing, wither, poison, slowness, mining fatigue, weakness, hunger, and levitation.
Piglin brutes are steadfast and cannot be distracted.
